query: What fidelity metrics and teacher-training protocol (hours, checklist items, monitoring cadence, remediation steps) will ensure consistent delivery and how will fidelity be analyzed?

response.query: What fidelity metrics and teacher-training protocol (hours, checklist items, monitoring cadence, remediation steps) will ensure consistent delivery and how will fidelity be analyzed?
response.answer: Fidelity metrics include adherence to protocol checklists and monitoring logs; teacher training involves 40 hours, checklists, weekly monitoring, and remediation steps; fidelity analyzed via direct observation and log reviews.
